newsitem.title: JAPAN: Janome Sewing up on TSE after company announcement.
newsitem.headline: Janome Sewing up on TSE after company announcement.

text.p: Shares of Janome Sewing Machine Co Ltd rose on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on Tuesday morning due to the company's announcement that it would liquidate two of its subsidiaries to improve its financial health, brokers said.
By 0058 GMT, Janome Sewing was up 15 yen, or five percent, to 315 yen.

It was the fourth largest percentage gainer on the first section of TSE. Janome Sewing said on Monday it would liquidate its wholly owned real estate subsidiary before the end of March. Janome also said that a credit company, in which it holds a 19 percent stack and has extended a loan of 28.6 billion yen, is expected to be liquidated by the end of March.
